positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Beyond the sunshine and long weekend, we have so much to be grateful for this Labor Day! Weekends, paid sick leave, pensions, health benefits, an end to child labor, social security, the list goes on and on. Thank you, Labor Movement!"

"Three cheers for Maryland! Yesterday, Maryland leaders signed a 5-year contract with the federal government to lift federal restrictions on the Medicare program and enact Maryland's Total Cost of Care All-Payer Model. The first-in-the-nation Maryland Model is designed to provide incentives to hospitals to shift the focus to "keeping people healthy and not making more money when more people are coming into the hospitals." The previous all-payer Model, approved in 2014, saved the state around $500 million. The new Maryland Model is expected to save the state around $1 billion over the next five years. If successful, this model could shape how other states shape their health care system ensuring quality health care for all while also saving Maryland taxpayers billions of dollars."
